title: llm-judge-source-accuracy: source-dependent accuracy of LLM judges on physician-written and LLM-written hospital-course summaries
description:
Analysis code, aggregate results and analysis plan for the manuscript Source-Dependent Accuracy of LLM Judges When Comparing Physician-Written and LLM-Written Hospital-Course Summaries. Using the published judge verdicts and complete physician labels of MIMIC-III-Ext-VeriFact-BHC v1.1.0 (100 patients, 9095 atomic claims), the scripts measure judge sensitivity and specificity by source and the error of judge-only rates across 126 judge settings, and simulate physician review of m patients to compare labels alone, Rogan-Gladen correction (shared and per source), prediction-powered inference within each source, and PPI++.

No data from the credentialed dataset are included: the scripts run locally on the PhysioNet release and print aggregate tables only, with counts between 1 and 10 masked. Code: MIT. Notes, plan excerpt and figures: CC BY 4.0.
